SELECT
    ap.id                         AS actual_production_id,
    ap.production_date            AS actual_production_date,
    ap.batch_no                   AS batch_number,
    ap.apq                        AS actual_quantity,
    p.production_no               AS production_number,
    p.production_date             AS planned_production_date,
    pr.product_name               AS product_name,
    c.category_name               AS category_name,
    pc.color                      AS product_color,
    ap.created_at                 AS record_created_at,
    ap.updated_at                 AS record_updated_at
FROM actual_production AS ap
LEFT JOIN production AS p
       ON ap.production_id = p.id
      AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN product AS pr
       ON ap.product_id = pr.id
      AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN category AS c
       ON ap.category_id = c.id
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN product_color AS pc
       ON ap.product_color_id = pc.id
      AND pc.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE ap.deleted_at IS NULL
LIMIT 20;
